reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) directly supports the key premises by showing a transition from parabolic to logarithmic kinetics with Al addition, formation of a dense protective Al2O3 layer at ≥10 at.% Al, suppression of Mn oxides and porosity, and reduction in oxide thickness. However, the evidence is from Mn-Al alloys, not the CoCrFeNiMn system specified in the hypothesis, and the claim about mechanical alloying is only indirectly supported by a reference to arc-melted alloys.
premises: Increasing Al content in a CoCrFeNiMn HEA changes oxidation kinetics from parabolic to logarithmic.
A logarithmic oxidation rate indicates formation of a dense, protective oxide layer.
Al content ≥10 at.% suppresses Mn-rich oxide formation and promotes a thin Al2O3-rich scale.
The protective Al2O3 layer reduces overall oxide thickness from ~25 μm to ~1 μm.
Mechanically alloyed HEAs behave similarly to arc-melted ones regarding Al effect on oxidation.
